items.summary: Captain Jarrod Bowen scored twice as West Ham's 3-2 win over Bolton took them top of the Sky Bet Championship on goal difference and earned a first ever win at the Toughsheet Community Stadium.

items.summary: Erling Haaland's double earned Manchester City a 2-0 win at FC Porto - but it was another game where Enzo Maresca's side won but struggled to convince.

Willock grabs late goal as Newcastle edge Millwall
items.summary: Joe Willock's late goal sent a relieved Newcastle into the fourth round of the Carabao Cup as the Premier League side scraped to a 1-0 victory at Sky Bet Championship outfit Millwall.

items.title: Christie nets hat-trick as Bournemouth blitz Championship Lincoln
items.summary: Ryan Christie scored a hat-trick to give Marco Rose his first win as Bournemouth manager as the Cherries swept aside Sky Bet Championship side Lincoln 4-0.

items.title: Southampton knock Swansea off Championship top spot
items.summary: Cyle Larin scored his fifth goal of the season as Southampton beat Swansea 3-1 to humble a table-topper for the second home match in a row.

items.title: Bouaddi impresses on first start - have Man City found 'a gem'?
items.summary: Ayyoub Bouaddi belies his age with a mature Champions League performance on his first Manchester City start to showcase why the club were so intent on signing the 18-year-old.

items.title: From shot-shy to shoot on sight - Villa find a way to win
items.summary: Aston Villa finally found their shooting boots with three goals at Club Brugge - but their win was not straightforward.
